decisions.reason: The particle therapy water phantom builds directly on the firm's long scanning-phantom and dosimetry expertise, and its niche clinical feedback is something the firm's physicists can interpret and use to refine it, so keeping it is justified despite its lack of recent web visibility.
Small volume chambers are core detector know-how supported by accredited calibration and growing small-field demand, so the firm can absorb lessons and keep improving the product.
This chamber draws on the same deep detector knowledge base and serves small-field dosimetry needs; ionization chambers typically stay on the market for many years.
A multi-model standard clinical chamber line is central to the established business and fully integrated into calibration and service capabilities.
The relative dosimetry chamber complements the firm's water phantoms and integrated QA workflow, using closely related knowledge that the firm can apply effectively.
